sample_dupes.label: Chicken pox
sample_dupes.text: I'm feeling fatigued and have no energy. I can barely keep my eyes open during the day, and I've been feeling lethargic and unable to motivate myself.

sample_dupes.label: Common Cold
sample_dupes.text: I've been quite exhausted and ill. My throat has been quite painful, and I've had a fairly nasty cough. I've got a lot of chills and a pretty high temperature. Just feeling extremely run down and weak

sample_dupes.label: Pneumonia
sample_dupes.text: I have a really high fever, and I have problems breathing. My heart is racing quite quickly, I'm perspiring a lot, and I feel chilly and exhausted. I'm also about to cough out some brownish phlegm.

sample_dupes.label: Pneumonia
sample_dupes.text: I'm having a hard time breathing and I feel really uncomfortable. I'm sweating a lot and there's a lot of phlegm in my throat. My chest hurts and my heart is beating fast. The mucus I'm coughing up is brownish.

sample_dupes.label: Pneumonia
sample_dupes.text: Lately I've been experiencing chills, fatigue, a cough, a high fever, and difficulty breathing. I've been sweating a lot and just feeling really sick and weak. I've also had some phlegm that's been really thick and dark.
